title: Characterize send-composition performance offline
summary: Consolidate the accepted adaptive-runtime chain into local main, preserve unrelated work, define the exact offline measurement authority, run a bounded four-configured-cell production loopback campaign, analyze three reachable effective signatures with held-out validation, and close without production activation or push.
planned_changes: Add measurement-only schemas and campaign definition; add a fixed internal performance authorization without changing policy mechanisms; extend the existing benchmark executable with a production loopback send-composition runner and bounded evidence collectors; add deterministic campaign, validation, analysis, and holdout scripts; execute pilot and accepted full cells; retain raw artifacts externally; publish compact reports and traceability; run adversarial and retained regressions; archive final main.
verification_plan: Validate campaign and result schemas; prove authorization denial and exact cell matching; run a short serial pilot and enforce variance and activation gates; run counterbalanced training and holdout blocks; validate checksums and classifications; recompute effect and selector reports twice; run all prior adaptive-runtime regressions, focused Release builds, focused mechanism and ownership tests, direct SpecTrace validation, and git diff --check; verify final archive and bundle hashes.
out_of_scope: Stage 5 ACK, crypto, HTTP/3, or QPACK development
Online learning or runtime model loading
Workload or host identity as runtime controller input
